checks.why: a listener in the app module runs only for tests whose module can load it: the app module's own real-context test, and a module depending on app transitively; not the core module's test, whose classpath does not hold the listener, and not the tests that publish through a mocked publisher
near miss: a listener in the core module is on every module's classpath, so the core test that publishes through a real context reaches it; the mocked publishers still do not
control: the publishing method itself is called directly by every test, mocked publisher or not
